decisions.quote: With respect to RQ1, the hierarchy between Sequence, Tracing, Explaining, and Writing programming skills does not replicate with structural equation modeling as one of the candidate “best” models. However, the original hierarchy is still within the top 10 BIC scores for exam 2 and notably similar hierarchies appear in the “best” models for exam 1 and 3. The answer to the research question, then, is that our results do not support the specific hierarchy proposed by Lopez et al. (2008) as the strongest hierarchy. However, similar models are among the set of models our results deem the “best”, supporting the existence of relationships between these skills in similar configurations.
decisions.reason: The authors frame their findings as partly supporting and partly not supporting Lopez et al. (2008): while the exact original hierarchy is not among the tied highest-BIC candidate models as the strongest hierarchy, key pairwise links and closely similar models do appear among the best models (and the authors conclude in Section 6.1 that the hierarchy as it exists is reasonably supported, though it may not be the best possible hierarchy).
